AR-A014418 may directly or indirectly inhibit JNK or other kinases, affecting chromatin-modifying complexes and resulting in the histone modification profile.
AR-A014418 may modulate AKT signaling, which can influence histone acetylation and methylation through downstream effectors, contributing to the observed changes.
AR-A014418 may act as a histone deacetylase inhibitor or affect histone methylation dynamics, either directly or through metabolic effects, leading to the specific mark changes.
AR-A014418 may alter nuclear receptor or BET bromodomain signaling, impacting histone acetylation and methylation patterns.
